display_long_description:
Get behind the wheel for the most immersive offroad experience in VR. Dirt Racing: SUV Offroad Challenge puts you in the cockpit of high-performance 4x4s to conquer punishing terrain, unpredictable weather, and aggressive AI rivals. This isn't just a game; it's a precision-tuned sim where every jump and drift feels dangerously real.

PHYSICAL VR CONTROLS
Step into a fully interactive cockpit where your hands do the driving.

Manual Handling: Grab the steering wheel, pull the handbrake for sharp drifts, and shift gears.

Tactile Interactions: Reach out to adjust your mirrors or blast the NOS to overtake the pack.

Pro Physics: Feel the weight of your vehicle with a suspension system built for realistic mud and dirt traction.

CONQUER EVERY TERRAIN
From high-speed stadium speedways to our signature dense jungle circuits, every race is a battle for the line. Navigate thick mud, steep hills, and lakeside trails where your reflexes are the difference between victory and a wipeout.

GAME FEATURES:
Three Competitive Modes: Dominate in Circuit Racing, Sprints, and Best Lap challenges.

Dynamic Environments: Master the dirt through changing light and weather cycles.

Aggressive AI: Trade paint with a full field of rivals fighting for the podium.

Deep Customization: Personalize your ride with a wide variety of unique liveries.

Global Leaderboards: Prove you’re the fastest 4x4 driver in the world.

Outrun the pack. Dominate the dirt. Own the trail.
